title: Incredible Tour with María R
text: Our tour guide was María R, and she gave us a heartfelt, in-depth private early access tour to the beautiful and historic Real Alcázar of Seville.   The early access was worth every penny, as you can experience the Alcazar before the crowds and get as many uninterrupted photos as you’d like. María was a great guide, explaining every section and landmark in detail. She provided great historical context, artistic and architectural insight, and a personal touch to the entire experience. author: Ridwan_M

title: Amazing Experience!
text:
This tour gives you access to the Alcazar before the general public.  This is a truly unique and phenomenal experience. 
Our tour guide was Raquel was amazing. She has a passion of love for history that is contagious. She truly made us enjoy and understand the remarkable history of this land. Highly recommend this tour.  If you can sign up and try to get Raquel.
author: dolcefarniente_83

title: Knowledgeable guide
text: Raquel was excellent in explaining the history of the Alcazar and of Seville in general.  This tour provided a great opportunity to walk through the palace and grounds before other guests arrived,  which was ideal for photo ops!

title: Early access with Alba
text: Alba was a great guide. She was very organised  and super knowledgable about the Alcazar.  Due to the storm the garden was closed but as a group we had lots of time to see the building's interior. The early start was worthwhile to avoid the crowds.
author: jennyrF1879VM

title: Incredible Tour of the Alcazar!!
text: Alba was amazing! She was extremely friendly, knowledgeable and passionate! You can tell she genuinely loves history and so many great insights to share. Highly recommend the early entry tour of the palace to give yourself time and space to see the palace and all the intricate detail and take pictures without hundreds of other people!
